nodes.label: Fine-Tuning Small Reasoning Models for Quantum Field Theory
nodes.author: Nathaniel S. Woodward, Zhiqi Gao, Yurii Kvasiuk, Kendrick M. Smith, Frederic Sala, Moritz Münchmeyer
nodes.rationale: Academic study of fine-tuning LLMs for theoretical physics reasoning, specifically QFT domain

nodes.label: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B Model
nodes.rationale: 7B parameter reasoning model selected for RL and SFT experiments due to suitable base capabilities and well-understood reasoning performance

nodes.label: QFT Easy Synthetic Dataset
nodes.rationale: ~1000 training problems with low operational difficulty, designed for models with lower reasoning ability

nodes.label: QFT Medium Synthetic Dataset
nodes.rationale: ~1000 training problems with medium operational difficulty, self-contained with guiding context

nodes.label: QFT Hard Synthetic Dataset
nodes.rationale: ~550 training problems with high operational difficulty, multi-step with minimal context

nodes.label: Verifiable QFT Training Data
nodes.rationale: Publicly released dataset of 2500+ synthetic QFT problems with auto-verifiable solutions via Python code

nodes.label: Synthetic Data Generation Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Robust pipeline for creating synthetic problems and adapting human-authored problems for verifiable training

nodes.label: Problem Structuring and Auto-Verification
nodes.rationale: Method requiring models to implement solutions in Python functions with test case verification

nodes.label: Five Verifiable Task Types in Theoretical Physics
nodes.rationale: Taxonomy of verifiable tasks: Direct Calculation, Hidden-Coefficient Derivation, Ratio/Comparison, Categorical Classification, Logical Consistency Checks

nodes.label: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)
nodes.rationale: Training method using expert solution trajectories to maximize token-wise likelihood of correct completions

nodes.label: Reinforcement Learning with GRPO
nodes.rationale: Group Relative Policy Optimization for RL training, eliminates need for critic model by using group-based relative rewards

nodes.label: Experiment 1: DeepSeek-7B RL on Easy QFT
nodes.rationale: RL fine-tuning achieving 40.2% → 54.2% on Easy QFT with strong transfer to Medium (26.2% → 44.0%)

nodes.label: Experiment 2: DeepSeek-7B SFT
nodes.rationale: SFT fine-tuning using Qwen3-30B teacher traces, achieving 59.7% on Easy QFT with better in-distribution performance than RL

nodes.label: Experiment 3: Narrow Domain RL - Fermions and Spinors
nodes.rationale: LoRA-based RL on 35 fermion/spinor problems showing targeted improvements without catastrophic forgetting

nodes.label: Distill-then-Classify Error Analysis Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Three-stage pipeline for analyzing reasoning errors: golden solution decomposition, CoT distillation, error classification

nodes.label: Four Error Categories
nodes.rationale: Factual, Mathematical, Logical, and Executional errors used to classify reasoning failures

nodes.label: Domain Difficulty
nodes.rationale: Depth of background knowledge required to comprehend a topic, ranging from undergraduate to postgraduate

nodes.label: Operational Difficulty
nodes.rationale: Mechanical and logical demands of solving a task independent of topic, primary driver of LLM solve rate

nodes.label: Qwen3-30B-A3B Teacher Model
nodes.rationale: Selected as optimal teacher model for SFT, producing reasoning traces most compatible with DeepSeek-7B learning

nodes.label: Gemini-2.5-Pro
nodes.rationale: Frontier model used for generating Easy and Medium QFT datasets

nodes.label: Gemini-3-Pro
nodes.rationale: Frontier model used for generating Hard QFT and human-adapted datasets, shows improved quality over Gemini-2.5-Pro

nodes.label: GPT-5
nodes.rationale: Frontier model used for verification of synthetic problems and quality grading

nodes.label: arXiv Problem Seeds
nodes.rationale: 397 problem seeds collected from ~100 theoretical physics arXiv manuscripts for evaluation

nodes.label: QFT Pedagogy Problem Seeds
nodes.rationale: 565 problem seeds from textbooks, exercise books, and MIT OCW for QFT pedagogy evaluation

nodes.label: Model Distillation
nodes.rationale: Both SFT and RL experiments execute model distillation from frontier models to smaller reasoning models

nodes.label: Chain-of-Thought Analysis
nodes.rationale: Extensive analysis of model reasoning traces before and after fine-tuning to understand error evolution

nodes.label: Backtracking and Self-Correction Analysis
nodes.rationale: Analysis of explicit self-correction events in reasoning traces, showing RL reallocates backtracking toward solvable problems

nodes.label: Curriculum Learning
nodes.rationale: Training on data organized from easy to hard, essential for efficient convergence in reasoning tasks

nodes.label: LoRA Fine-Tuning
nodes.rationale: Low-rank adaptation used for narrow domain fine-tuning on small datasets to reduce overfitting

nodes.label: Rejection Sampling
nodes.rationale: Filtering technique to retain only correct reasoning traces for SFT training

nodes.label: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)
nodes.rationale: RL algorithm that eliminates critic model by using group-based relative rewards, improves training stability

nodes.label: Verl Framework
nodes.rationale: Framework used for RL full fine-tuning experiments

nodes.label: Axolotl Framework
nodes.rationale: Framework used for SFT fine-tuning experiments

nodes.label: Five-Point Quality Evaluation Protocol
nodes.rationale: Evaluation criteria: Output-Seed Correspondence, Problem Definition, Solution Completeness, Explanatory Quality, Test Case Quality

nodes.label: Calculation Conventions Challenge
nodes.rationale: Challenge in data curation: arbitrary physics conventions (metric signatures, normalizations) must be fixed for code verification

nodes.label: Synthetic Data Generation Challenges
nodes.rationale: Challenges: incorrect frontier model solutions, calculation conventions, test case generation, code implementation errors

nodes.label: Performance Transfer from Easy to Medium QFT
nodes.rationale: RL training on Easy QFT induces strong zero-shot transfer to Medium problems (26.2% → 44.0%)

nodes.label: Factual Error Reduction
nodes.rationale: Both RL and SFT primarily reduce factual errors (37% reduction in frequency), suggesting domain-specific grounding as primary mechanism

nodes.label: Mathematical Error Persistence
nodes.rationale: Mathematical errors remain most prevalent post-finetuning, suggesting algebraic manipulation as principal bottleneck

nodes.label: RL vs SFT Generalization Trade-off
nodes.rationale: SFT achieves higher in-distribution performance on synthetic tasks, while RL generalizes better to out-of-distribution benchmarks

nodes.label: Trace Length Redistribution Effect
nodes.rationale: RL reallocates computation toward solvable problems with longer correct traces and shorter incorrect traces

nodes.label: Operational Difficulty as Primary Performance Driver
nodes.rationale: Analysis shows operational complexity, not domain knowledge depth, is primary driver of LLM solve rate

nodes.label: Academic Compute Constraints
nodes.rationale: RL requires 160 GPU hours vs SFT 75 minutes, making RL prohibitively expensive for standard academic budgets

nodes.label: QFT Synthetic Dataset (Easy/Medium/Hard)
nodes.rationale: Benchmark dataset for evaluating physics reasoning across difficulty levels; used to measure baseline performance of proprietary and open-weight LLMs

nodes.label: Human-Adapted Validation Sets (arXiv, QFT Pedagogy)
nodes.rationale: Real-world physics problems from arXiv and pedagogical sources; used to validate synthetic dataset difficulty calibration

nodes.label: TP-Bench Benchmark
nodes.rationale: External physics reasoning benchmark with 5 difficulty levels; used as independent validation of synthetic dataset calibration

nodes.label: Claude Opus 4.5
nodes.rationale: Proprietary model used as difficulty metric; performance degradation from Easy (81.5%) to Hard (44.5%) validates Hard dataset challenge

nodes.label: Qwen3 4B Thinking
nodes.rationale: Open-weight model demonstrating trade-off between extended reasoning (2× token cost) and limited accuracy gains on Hard problems

nodes.label: DeepSeek R1 Distill Qwen 7B
nodes.rationale: Open-weight model showing complete failure (0.0 accuracy) on Hard synthetic dataset

nodes.label: OSS 20B
nodes.rationale: Open-weight model achieving highest accuracy (22.2%) on Hard dataset with efficient token usage (8.1k tokens)

nodes.label: Dimensional Regularization
nodes.rationale: Physics framework used in QFT synthetic problems; convention for reporting divergent coefficients

nodes.label: Loop Integral Divergences
nodes.rationale: Core physics concept in synthetic problem generation; computing pole coefficients and matching subtraction

nodes.label: Chain-of-Thought Analysis Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Three-stage error classification system (Stage 2: distillation, Stage 3: classification) for analyzing model reasoning chains

nodes.label: Error Categories (Mathematical, Logical, Executional, Factual)
nodes.rationale: Taxonomy for classifying reasoning failures; shows inherent ambiguity in error categorization across different LLM judges

nodes.label: SFT Dataset (Supervised Fine-Tuning)
nodes.rationale: Training data for fine-tuning models; 195.0M total tokens across Easy/Medium/Hard with varying success rates by model

nodes.label: RL Training Metrics (Score, Entropy, Response Length)
nodes.rationale: Diagnostic plots showing convergence behavior during reinforcement learning; score plateaus at ~2000 steps with entropy decline

nodes.label: Reasoning Cliff Phenomenon
nodes.rationale: Sharp performance dropoff at TP-Bench Level 3; all models show dramatic accuracy decline, indicating fundamental reasoning limitation

nodes.label: arXiv Domain-Specific Performance Variance
nodes.rationale: Models perform best on math-ph and gr-qc, degrade on hep-ph and class-ph; indicates domain-specific reasoning challenges

hyperedges.label: QFT Physics Reasoning Evaluation Framework
hyperedges.rationale: Integrated evaluation framework combining synthetic, human-adapted, and external benchmarks to measure physics reasoning; reasoning cliff phenomenon observed across all

hyperedges.label: Model Performance Analysis Across Difficulty Levels
hyperedges.rationale: Comparative analysis of proprietary and open-weight models showing performance degradation patterns; Claude used as difficulty metric
